name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.42-beta “Paris” (build 47): fixes.
• Starting after an update is quick again: choosing “Install When I Quit” and later “Relaunch Now” no longer puts the update in place twice at the same time, which could hold up quitting and the next start.
• An empty “Software Update” window could appear while LitArbi quit to install an update, and keep it from closing. If the update can't be started while quitting, LitArbi now says so at the next start and tries again later.
• Build 46: Submission ▸ Restore Citation Links; early-adopter offers for beta testers.
